proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Shares an apartment with Ned back in New York after MIT.

their_evidence: Plot: 'Ned and MJ move back to New York after graduating from MIT'; MJ 'invites him to her and Ned's apartment, where a masked Parker bonds with them both.'

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes Logan into his school after the X-Men save him and Rogue, and offers to help him uncover his lost past. Logan stays and fights for him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes Logan in and offers to help him find his past.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A drifter Xavier takes into his school and turns into an X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future where Sentinels hunt mutants, Xavier asks Logan to travel back to 1973 and guide his younger self. When history changes, Logan wakes to find Xavier alive and his school thriving.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sends Logan back to 1973 to save the future.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Xavier sends back in time to change history.

proposed.title: The Wolverine
proposed.text: Two years after Japan, Xavier, long believed dead, reveals himself to Logan at an airport and backs Magneto's warning about a weapon that could end the mutant race.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Believed dead, returns to warn Logan of a threat to all mutants.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Xavier comes back to warn of a threat to all mutants.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: Logan, back in the US two years later, is approached at the airport by Erik, who warns of a weapon that would end the mutant race; Logan refuses to believe him until Charles Xavier, presumed dead, reveals himself working alongside Erik.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Rogue to power his machine, and Logan fights through the Brotherhood at the Statue of Liberty to save her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kidnaps Rogue, and Logan fights through the Brotherhood to save her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A clawed X-Man who wrecks Magneto's plan at Liberty Island.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: To stop Stryker, Logan works alongside a freed Magneto, until Magneto turns Stryker's Cerebro against every human on Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Works with Logan against Stryker, then betrays them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man Magneto works beside against Stryker.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Magneto leads the Brotherhood's attack on Alcatraz, and Logan keeps him busy while Beast injects him with the cure.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Leads the attack on Alcatraz, where Logan keeps him busy for Beast's cure.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Helps strip Magneto's powers at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, Magneto fights beside Xavier and helps send Logan's mind back to 1973.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fights beside Xavier and helps send Logan back to 1973.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Magneto helps send back to 1973.

proposed.title: The Wolverine
proposed.text: Magneto approaches Logan at an airport and warns him that humans are building a weapon that would end the mutant race. Logan does not believe him until Xavier appears at Magneto's side.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Warns Logan of a weapon built to end the mutant race.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man Magneto warns of a weapon built to end the mutant race.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: Erik Lehnsherr approaches Logan at the airport and warns him of a weapon humans are creating that would end the mutant race; Logan refuses to believe him until Xavier reveals he is working with Erik.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles saves Erik from drowning as he chases Shaw, and the two become close friends who recruit young mutants together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's closest friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Erik's closest friend.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Charles and Erik are old friends who long ago took opposite sides over humanity. After the X-Men stop his machine, Charles visits him in his plastic prison to play chess.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old friend and rival.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Magneto's old friend on the other side.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: The two once visited young Jean together to bring her to the school. Now they race to her family home, where the Phoenix kills Charles and leaves with Erik.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Watches Charles die and leaves with Jean.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The old friend whose death Erik witnesses.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, the old rivals fight side by side and send Logan back to change history.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's old rival, now fighting beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fights beside Magneto in a last stand.

proposed.title: The Wolverine
proposed.text: Charles, long believed dead, is working alongside Erik again, and the two come to Logan together to warn him of a threat to all mutants.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's old rival, working beside him again.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Believed dead, now working beside Erik again.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: Xavier, presumed dead after The Last Stand, reveals himself to be working alongside Lehnsherr as Erik warns Logan at the airport.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ben is Reed's oldest friend and joins him on Doom's station. When the storm turns Ben to stone, Reed vows to cure him, and Ben chooses to stay the Thing to save Reed from Doom.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Reed's best friend. Chooses to stay the Thing to save him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's best friend, who vows to find him a cure.

proposed.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
proposed.text: Ben throws Reed a bachelor party before his wedding to Sue and gets him onto the dance floor, then fights beside him against the Surfer and Doom.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Throws Reed a bachelor party before the wedding.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's best friend, whose bachelor party he throws.

their_evidence: Early in the film Reed attends a bachelor party (Sue: 'I'm glad you had fun... nothing compared to what I did at my bachelorette party'); Ben hosts it and pushes Reed to dance. The team then fights the Surfer and Doom together (Ben knocks Doom off the board).

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ben and Johnny are changed by the same storm and become teammates. Johnny teases Ben about his rocky body, and the two trade jokes and pranks.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's teammate, a showoff who never stops teasing him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Johnny's rocky teammate and favorite target for jokes.

proposed.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
proposed.text: After the Surfer leaves Johnny able to swap powers by touch, Ben trades powers with him for a moment. Later, when Johnny takes the whole team's powers to fight Doom, Ben knocks Doom off the board with a crane.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Swaps powers with Ben for a moment, then takes on Doom with his help.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Swaps powers with Johnny, then knocks Doom off the board for him.

their_evidence: Ben 'enjoyed the opportunity to briefly swap powers with Johnny to demonstrate Johnny's odd condition'; when Johnny borrows the team's powers to oppose Victor, 'Ben uses a demolition crane to knock Doom off the Surfer's board'.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue and Ben share the cosmic storm and become teammates. She stands by him after his change and fights beside him against Doom.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sue's teammate and friend, turned to stone by the storm.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's teammate and friend, Reed's great love.

proposed.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
proposed.text: In London, Sue holds the falling London Eye level with a force field so Ben can lift it back into place and save its riders.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Lifts the London Eye back into place while Sue holds it level.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Holds the London Eye level so Ben can lift it back.

their_evidence: The team saves the London Eye and its passengers in London; Sue's force fields 'level a large building structure so Ben could lift it back into place', and Ben lifts 'a large building structure (about 1,000 tons) with Sue leveling it'.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War

stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man who crash lands in the Sanctum to warn of Thanos.

their_evidence: S2E6 (running #16): at the Church of Gibborim the Runaways find two Dematerialization Boxes; 'Hernandez ripped open the other to find Geoffrey Wilder. Hernandez used her strength to carry him out of the room and back to the Hostel.' (ref RW206)

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Dr. Dan Lewis is Anne's new boyfriend, and he examines Eddie when the symbiote makes him sick. He finds that it is harming Eddie's organs.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Anne's new boyfriend, a doctor who helps Eddie.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Anne's ex, a patient who becomes a friend.

proposed.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
proposed.text: When Frances takes Anne, Dan calls Eddie to tell him where she is, then helps him at Grace Cathedral by setting Carnage on fire.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Eddie when Anne is taken, then sets Carnage on fire.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Anne's ex, whom Dan calls when Frances takes her.

their_evidence: Eddie advises Dan and Anne to leave San Francisco; after Shriek abducts Anne, Dan 'called Brock and told him that Shriek and Kasady captured Weying and took her to Grace Cathedral', then 'doused Carnage with burning gasoline'.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Mrs. Chen runs the corner store Eddie shops at, and the two are friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The corner store owner, a friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A regular at Mrs. Chen's store, and a friend.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: In Las Vegas, Eddie and Venom reunite with Mrs. Chen, and she dances with Venom before the Xenophage and Strickland's soldiers ambush them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Eddie's old friend, reunited with him in Las Vegas.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mrs. Chen's old friend, back in her life in Las Vegas.

proposed.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
proposed.text: Mrs. Chen keeps Eddie supplied with chocolate in exchange for Venom guarding her store. When Anne comes looking for Venom, she scolds her for breaking Eddie's heart.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trades chocolate for Venom guarding her store.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend whose Venom guards Mrs. Chen's store.

their_evidence: Mrs. Chen 'made a deal with Eddie, so he would protect her as Venom in exchange for chocolate supplies' (ref Let There Be Carnage); she 'angrily accuse[s] [Anne] of breaking Eddie Brock's heart'.
